mechanism: Valproic acid may increase everolimus levels through inhibition of CYP3A4 and potentially affecting protein binding, while everolimus may increase valproic acid levels through competition for hepatic metabolism and glucuronidation.
action: Monitor everolimus and valproic acid levels closely; consider dose adjustment of everolimus if co-administered; assess for signs of everolimus toxicity (stomatitis, infections, metabolic effects) and valproic acid toxicity (tremor, sedation, hepatotoxicity).
